Shein IPO Valued Lower Than Previous Peaks Amid Growth Concerns

Fast-fashion retailer Shein is preparing for its Hong Kong IPO, with its valuation significantly reduced from its 2022 peak. The company was valued at $26 billion, a fraction of the $100 billion it reached two years prior. This lower valuation comes amid ongoing unease about Shein's growth outlook. The IPO is scheduled to debut on Tuesday.
